sentences.t: 你要是不幫他，他做不到的。
sentences.en: If you don't help him, he won't make it.

sentences.s: 汤姆进房间时没有微笑。
sentences.t: 湯姆進房間時沒有微笑。
sentences.en: Tom wasn't smiling when he entered the room.

sentences.s: 奇怪的是，谁也没有投那候选人一票。
sentences.t: 奇怪的是，誰也沒有投那候選人一票。
sentences.en: Strange to say, no one voted for the candidate.

sentences.s: 我没想到汤姆会害怕。
sentences.t: 我沒想到湯姆會害怕。
sentences.en: I didn't think Tom would be scared.

sentences.s: 许多著名的画家居住在澳洲。
sentences.t: 許多著名的畫家居住在澳洲。
sentences.en: A number of famous artists live in Australia.

sentences.s: 祝您一切顺利。
sentences.t: 祝您一切順利。
sentences.en: We wish you the best of luck in your endeavors.

sentences.s: 简直就像电影里的一幕一样，不是吗？
sentences.t: 簡直就像電影裏的一幕一樣，不是嗎？
sentences.en: It's like a scene from a movie, isn't it?

sentences.s: 不管什么电影，我都喜欢看。
sentences.t: 不管什麼電影，我都喜歡看。
sentences.en: I like to watch all kinds of movies. (Lit. No matter what movie, I like to watch them all.)

sentences.s: 看来他很好。
sentences.t: 看來他很好。
sentences.en: It seems that he is fine.

sentences.s: 老人独自生活。
sentences.t: 老人獨自生活。
sentences.en: The old man lived by himself.

sentences.s: 楼这么高，你上得来吗？
sentences.t: 樓這麼高，你上得來嗎？
sentences.en: The building is so high, are you able to come up?

sentences.s: 我不知道你今天回家之前本来是要那样做。
sentences.t: 我不知道你今天回家之前本來是要那樣做。
sentences.en: I didn't know that you were planning on doing that before you went home today.

sentences.s: 我们把它留到明天吧。
sentences.t: 我們把它留到明天吧。
sentences.en: Let's leave that until tomorrow.

sentences.s: 她一回家就看电视。
sentences.t: 她一回家就看電視。
sentences.en: As soon as she gets home, (then) she watches TV.

sentences.s: 你不能把你的车停在这里。
sentences.t: 你不能把你的車停在這裏。
sentences.en: You can't park your car here.

sentences.s: 为什么喜欢喝浓咖啡？
sentences.t: 爲什麼喜歡喝濃咖啡？
sentences.en: Why do you like coffee strong?

sentences.s: 有人告诉过我，我们每抽一根烟，寿命就会缩短七分钟。
sentences.t: 有人告訴過我，我們每抽一根菸，壽命就會縮短七分鐘。
sentences.en: Someone told me that every cigarette you smoke takes seven minutes away from your life.

sentences.s: 我决定不告诉汤姆发生了什么事。
sentences.t: 我決定不告訴湯姆發生了什麼事。
sentences.en: I decided not to tell Tom about what had happened.

sentences.s: 不过她这么小，这本书我不知道她是否能读懂。
sentences.t: 不過她這麼小，這本書我不知道她是否能讀懂。
sentences.en: But she is so young, I don't know if she can read this book.

sentences.s: 我要一件新衬衫。你想要什么？
sentences.t: 我要一件新襯衫。你想要什麼？
sentences.en: I want a new shirt. What do you want?

sentences.s: 我怀疑汤姆是不是真的想和玛丽一起去澳大利亚。
sentences.t: 我懷疑湯姆是不是真的想和瑪麗一起去澳大利亞。
sentences.en: I wonder if Tom really wanted to go to Australia with Mary.

sentences.s: 我这个下午本来想去逛街。
sentences.t: 我這個下午本來想去逛街。
sentences.en: I had intended to go shopping this afternoon.

sentences.s: 没有必要这么生气。
sentences.t: 沒有必要這麼生氣。
sentences.en: There's no need to get so angry.

sentences.s: 这张票这辆巴士能用吗？
sentences.t: 這張票這輛巴士能用嗎？
sentences.en: Is this ticket good for this bus?

sentences.s: 有人看见他上楼。
sentences.t: 有人看見他上樓。
sentences.en: He was seen to go upstairs.

sentences.s: 你到底是用了什么办法在短期内提高了你的汉语？
sentences.t: 你到底是用了什麼辦法在短期內提高了你的漢語？
sentences.en: Exactly what method did you use to improve your Mandarin in such a short space of time?

sentences.s: 好好学习。
sentences.t: 好好學習。
sentences.en: Study hard.

sentences.s: 她总和她父母吵架。
sentences.t: 她總和她父母吵架。
sentences.en: She was always quarreling with her parents.

sentences.s: 我们要六张门票，两张是学生票，这是我们的学生证。
sentences.t: 我們要六張門票，兩張是學生票，這是我們的學生證。
sentences.en: We need six tickets, two of them are student tickets, here is our student identity card.

sentences.s: 他急忙地离开办公室。
sentences.t: 他急忙地離開辦公室。
sentences.en: He left his office in a hurry.

sentences.s: 我一开始不知道汤姆是谁。
sentences.t: 我一開始不知道湯姆是誰。
sentences.en: I didn't know who Tom was at first.

sentences.s: 这听起来很奇怪。
sentences.t: 這聽起來很奇怪。
sentences.en: That sounds strange to me.

sentences.s: 我今天早上只吃了一块吐司和喝了一杯咖啡。
sentences.t: 我今天早上只喫了一塊吐司和喝了一杯咖啡。
sentences.en: I only had a piece of toast and a cup of coffee this morning.

sentences.s: 所有的老师都无法解决这个问题。
sentences.t: 所有的老師都無法解決這個問題。
sentences.en: None of the teachers could solve the problem.

sentences.s: 除了相信对方以外，你们没什么要做的了。
sentences.t: 除了相信對方以外，你們沒什麼要做的了。
sentences.en: All you need to do is trust each other.

sentences.s: 你迟到了一刻钟。
sentences.t: 你遲到了一刻鐘。
sentences.en: You are late for 15 minutes.
